title: inference/0.1
description: Profile for records with classical inference (R lm/estimatr, statsmodels, Stata regress). Requires, on top of the core: estimate and std_error on every row that isn't dropped, and p_value too except on variance-component and ancillary rows (component random or auxiliary); a row's own df, when present, gives its t test; metrics.nobs; a default vcov (the one marked default, or the only one) with type and ssc.convention; and metrics.df_residual unless that vcov has no df_t (absent or null: normal reference distribution, z tests and intervals).

df.description: The row's own df: when present, its test and interval use a t distribution on this df instead of the default vcov's df_t (Satterthwaite or Kenward-Roger df in mixed models, Rubin's df under multiple imputation); the vcov's df_t is then null.

else.description: p_value too, except on variance-component and ancillary rows (component random or auxiliary), which tools often report without a test (Stata's log SDs and me* variances, nbreg's /lnalpha, lme4).

vcov.description: At most one vcov is the default; the default (or a lone vcov) needs type and ssc with at least convention.

then.description: No df_residual: the default vcov (or the lone one) must have no df_t, i.e. z tests.
